stock.description: Anhui Conch Material Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sale of cement and concrete admixtures, as well as their associated intermediate products. Its operations extend across the People's Republic of China and Southwest Asia. The company's offerings include crucial intermediate chemicals such as processed alcohol amine, polyether monomer, and polycarboxylic acid mother liquor. Furthermore, it manufactures and distributes grinding aids designed for intelligent quality monitoring systems. This firm was established in 2018 and is headquartered in Wuhu, China.
